BlogHistory.title: BlogHistory
BlogHistory.description: Records of generated blog posts for duplication checks

publishDate.description: The date the post was generated/published

target.description: The target audience (e.g., 직장인, 주부, 학생, 노년층, 교통사고환자)

situation.description: The situation or context (e.g., 업무피로, 스포츠손상, 환절기면역)

treatments.description: The treatments used (e.g., 침, 도침, 한약, 다이어트 한약, 약침, 경옥고, 공진단, 추나)

/blog_history/{historyId}.description: Stores the history of generated blog posts
